prompt:
Draw ONE complete RED KING (雷德王), classic 1966 Ultraman episode 8 appearance, as a canonical arcade pixel-art model sprite. Fixed STRICT SIDE VIEW, FACING RIGHT, full body fighting idle pose; camera exactly horizontal, no three-quarter frontal torso. True transparent background, 透明背景.

Attachments 1-3 are REAL OFFICIAL PRODUCT PHOTOS and are the identity truth: use their exact small head, long thick tapering ringed neck, granular segmented skin, stocky muscular arms, stout legs, and ONE long thick-to-thin pointed tail. Attachment 4 is the approved Gomora pixel model: STYLE ONLY, do not copy Gomora's head, horns, ears, claws or scales. Attachment 5 is approved Ultraseven: STYLE ONLY. Match their fine native pixel density, upper-left lighting, restrained 32-color clusters and 1 logical-pixel dark outline. Deliberate true crisp pixel clusters; no antialiasing, blur, soft painting, 3D render or toy seams.

Identity details from the photographs: a very SMALL, compact wedge/conical skull at the top of a disproportionately LONG THICK tapering neck. The slightly pointed skull top is continuous skull shape, NOT a separate horn. Short broad blunt muzzle, small deeply set DARK eye under heavy brow, wide slightly open dark reddish-brown mouth with a few irregular small ivory teeth. Absolutely NO horns, NO nose horn, NO ear horns, NO protruding ears, NO antennae, NO crest, NO dorsal triangular spikes. Thick rounded transverse body rings, with round rectangular granular nodules subdividing the sides, arms, legs and tail. Thick horizontal belly rings. Rounded bumpy dorsal rows, not sharp armor. Thick short muscular arms held forward with elbows bent, short chunky curled fingers, no long sickle claws. Stout feet and short toes. Colors are pale gray-sand/ivory-beige on raised nodules, muted blue-gray/teal-gray grooves, deep charcoal-blue outlines, dark eye; NEVER red skin, never bright golden-yellow everywhere. Do not copy visible action-figure joints, screws or mechanical cuts.

Pose: upright heavy biped with slight fighting knee bend, near arm held forward at lower chest height, far forearm visibly staggered above/behind it, both distinct feet grounded on one baseline. Head and whole torso face RIGHT in profile. Native standing height 176 logical pixels, from skull top to soles. Small skull about 20-24 logical pixels high, long ringed neck about 40 logical pixels, broad body with strong upper arms. Preserve photographed proportions rather than a generic short-neck dinosaur. Make far-side WHOLE arm and WHOLE leg consistently a darker desaturated shade while generating the image; retain near-side bright sand skin and torso lighting. Near/far crossing boundaries have a complete ONE logical-pixel dark contour. This shading must already exist in the generated frame.

Tail: a single COMPLETE LONG TAPERING tail from rear hips extends far BACK TO THE LEFT, thick base with the same granular rings, gently lowered center and slightly raised thin pointed tip, consistent with photo 3's rear-side full-body view. Tail centerline roughly 0.9-1.05 of skull-to-ground standing height. No stump, no cropping, no tail club, no independent floating tail or particles. Fit the entire character and full tail comfortably within this 1536x1024 transparent image, with at least 40 output pixels of empty margin on every side; do not squash, distort or shorten the tail. Subject height about 820 output pixels, logical pixel blocks about 4-5 output pixels. One coherent WHOLE-BODY image only, no body-part composition, no text, no labels, no ground, shadow, aura, dust, rock or second character. 透明背景，真正PNG Alpha透明，角色以外完全透明。
